summary: NovaBridge Biosciences filed a Form 6-K to disclose the adoption of a 2026 Omnibus Share Incentive Plan approved by its board on July 13, 2026. The plan authorizes an initial issuance of up to 11,960,000 ordinary shares, with annual increases capped at 3% of outstanding shares. This is a routine equity incentive plan adoption, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, liquidation, or other special-situation category applies. The filing serves as a standard compensation tool to attract and retain employees.
